redfin.remarks: FINAL PRICE REDUCTION + SELLER-PROVIDED HOA FEES! Seller has reduced the price by an additional $20,000 and will pay the buyer’s first year of HOA fees—making this one of the most compelling opportunities currently available in DTLA. Don’t miss this exceptional 10th-floor loft in the iconic Rowan Building, a designated Mills Act property offering potential property tax savings of up to 70% annually. Bright, peaceful, and filled with authentic character, this true LIVE/WORK residence features soaring 10-foot ceilings, distinctive arched architectural details , exposed brick , and an entire wall of oversized industrial windows that flood the space with natural light throughout the day. The open, flexible floor plan is thoughtfully designed for both living and working, with a custom Murphy bed and built-in storage system that easily transforms the space from stylish home to inspiring workspace. Additional features include central heat and air, in-unit laundry, and a spacious bathroom with a deep soaking tub and shower. Residents enjoy an impressive collection of amenities, including a restored historic lobby, 24/7 front desk and security, controlled access, resident lounge, landscaped garden courtyards, plunge pools, BBQ areas, bike storage, and gated covered parking available for an additional monthly fee. Located in the heart of DTLA’s Historic Core, just moments from Grand Central Market, Little Tokyo, Gallery Row, Metro access, acclaimed restaurants, nightlife, and live music venues. Experience authentic Downtown LA loft living with exceptional historic character, modern functionality, and a newly improved value.
